projects.title: Behavioral Finance-Based Stock Market Predictor
projects.description: Applied Behavioral Finance concepts to algorithmic stock trading, achieving a 7.12% increase within 3 months in account value using investor trends from Google Search data. Researched the correlation between search volume and stock value.Developed algorithms that outperformed the Dow Jones Industrial Average in short term trading by leveraging psychological factors such as Herd Behavior and Mental Accounting. Wrote a research paper on my findings, validated by the district board.

honors_and_awards.title: Apple WWDC Student Hackathon Winner
honors_and_awards.description: Developed a web application informing users about poor waste-management practices, and offered a game to improve proper waste disposal habits. Won the “Most-Impact” award for the web application at my high school hackathon. Integrated the web application into an iOS app. Modified the app by adding an image classification machine-learning library (YOLO); the camera could detect the object and return the correct bin to put the object into
